test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

The nation has chosen the __government by the people__ over monarchy.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **democracy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"democracy"** means a system of government by the whole population, typically through elected representatives. (लोकतंत्र)

 
 
• **Example:** India is the world's largest democracy, where citizens elect their leaders through voting.
 
 
 
• **"Government by the people"** refers to a form of government in which the people have the authority to deliberate and decide legislation (direct democracy) or to choose governing officials to do so (representative democracy). (जनता द्वारा सरकार)
 
 
• **Example:** The United States is a government by the people, where citizens have the power to elect their leaders.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "government by the people" is best replaced by "democracy".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **democracy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Oligarchy **(गुटतंत्र): A small group of people having control of a country, organization, or institution.

 
 
• **Example:** The country was run by an oligarchy of wealthy families.
 
 
 
• **Theocracy** (धर्मतंत्र): A system of government in which priests rule in the name of God or a god.
 
 
• **Example:** Iran is an example of a theocracy where religious leaders have significant influence over the government.
 
 
 
• **Autocracy** (स्वेच्छाचारिता): A system of government by one person with absolute power.
 
 
• **Example:** North Korea is often cited as an example of an autocracy due to the centralization of power in one leader.
